<thought>Search the template catalog for a retrosynthetic template that breaks an aliphatic hydroxyl group and forms a halide (generic), using a simple aliphatic alcohol as the target molecule. This should locate the substitution template we need, from which we can extract its mapped reaction SMILES and template ID.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "CCO",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aliphatic hydroxyls"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["halide"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
